verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents proxy support with authentication (gh-19, docs-6) and an 'automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback' feature (gh-4). That implies it can cycle through multiple proxies when a request fails, but the evidence never describes an actual rotating-pool strategy. Missing for 10: explicit rotating proxy pool or rotation strategy documentation, per-request IP rotation configuration, and independent or hands-on confirmation that rotation avoids blocks.
